sections.shortTitle: Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Elections Fifth Amendment Order 1985
sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 8, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Fifth Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 8 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
8 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th January, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President on the 17th January, 1985, is hereby
published for general information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Houses of Parliament and
Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Fifth Amend ment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 11, P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In the Houses of Parliament and Provincial
Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], in Article
11, in clause (1),-
(a) the commas, words and figure
", as provided in Article 113 of the Constitution," shall be omitted
;
(b) after paragraph (c), the
following new paragraphs shall be added, namely :-
"(d) he is
of good character and is not commonly known as one who violates Islamic
Injunctions ;
(e) he has
adequate knowledge of Islamic teachings and practises obligatory duties
prescribed by Islam as well as abstains from major sins ;
(f) he is
sagacious, righteous and not profligate and honest and ameen;
(g) he has not
been convicted for a crime involving moral turpitude or for giving false
evidence ; and
(h) he has not,
after the establishment of Pakistan, worked against the integrity of the
country or opposed the Ideology of Pakistan:
Provided that
the disqualifications specified in paragraph (d) and (e) shall not apply to a
person who is a non-Muslim, but such a person shall have a good moral
reputation." ; and
(c) the words and figure
"and has made oath as provided for in Article 7" shall be omitted.
